notebooks.neqsim_version: 3.17.0 Python bridge with Java classes source-built from the exact equinor/neqsim master snapshot
notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 14 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py. Maven compiled the exact recorded NeqSim source checkout through target/classes; because the restricted shell could not download the final Maven archiver plugins, the local gate packaged those compiled classes into a source-classes JAR and used the verified public-PyPI 3.17.0 shaded JAR only for third-party dependency resolution. JPype loaded the main-only DynamicCapabilityReport and all NeqSim classes from the source-classes JAR. The pull-request workflow independently performs the normal full Maven package build from the same commit. The run retained every table and six PNG figures, with zero stored errors and zero stderr streams.

rendered_visual_validation.notes: All six retained figures were extracted at original resolution and inspected individually and in a contact sheet. Titles, axes, units, legends or color scale, depth orientation, colors, scales, clipping, overlap and consistency with retained tables passed. All three display equations rendered with correct fractions, overdots, subscripts, bars, Greek symbols, vectors and units. The final nbconvert HTML conversion passed; its six missing-alt warnings are mitigated by adjacent observation, mechanism, implication and recommendation text for every figure.

notebooks.documentation_impact: Adds a Northern Lights section, governed series roadmap, full data attribution, shared data loader, a direct catalog entry and a source-build CI workflow. It does not change a public NeqSim Java API, numerical default or OPM Flow recommendation.
notebooks.issue_handling: No NeqSim defect or missing public API invalidated the first notebook. Missing composition, formation-water chemistry, detailed pressure/test records, completion geometry, dynamic reservoir execution and geomechanical acceptance are treated as explicit data/model gates for later notebooks rather than NeqSim defects.
